Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) study using EDC. While the paper discusses phosphorylation extensively, the specific PRIDE dataset (PXD031997) focuses on the cross-linking of dephosphorylated PKD1KD. Acquisition is inferred as DDA based on the use of MaxQuant and Q Exactive HF-X for a standard XL-MS discovery workflow.

scope: All recombinant proteins used in this study were purified to homogeneity and subsequently analyzed by intact mass spectrometry to confirm their purity and precise chemical identity

PKD1 kinase domain (residues 570-890), dephosphorylated and purified to homogeneity was preincubated with 1mM ATP, 2mM MgCl2 in 40mM MES buffer pH 6.5 with 100mM NaCl before starting the crosslinking reaction
Cross-linking of PKD1KD (0P) was performed in 40 mM MES pH 6.5 and 100 mM NaCl.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis (XL-MS and HDX-MS) was performed on purified recombinant PKD1 kinase domain (PKD1KD) in solution, not on cell lysates.

The primary biological variable is the genetic status (WT vs various point mutations).
